project_type: Streamlit single-page app with Chroma vector store, BM25 lexical index, and OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint
build_system: No build step. Run with: streamlit run app.py (from rag-helpdesk/ directory)
test_framework: pytest — run from rag-helpdesk/ with: python -m pytest tests/ -v
build_command: No compile step. Lint: python -m py_compile app.py src/rag_pipeline/*.py
verification_instructions: 1. python -m py_compile app.py  -- must produce no errors. 2. python -m pytest tests/ -v -- all tests must pass. 3. Manual smoke: streamlit run app.py, ask 'What is a black hole?', confirm Agent Activity expander appears and shows question_type, retrieval_plan, attempt details, and final_decision.
environment_constraints: Do NOT start the Streamlit dev server. All verification is via py_compile + pytest. The .env file has real API keys — do not echo them. Tests that call the LLM must be skipped when LLM_API_KEY is missing (use pytest.mark.skipif). Working directory for all commands: c:\Users\shrey\Desktop\AGENTIC RAG-MODEL-main\RAG-MODEL-main\rag-helpdesk
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing patterns: snake_case functions, type hints, no new dependencies beyond what requirements.txt already contains.
key_patterns: 1. UI render functions are named _render_*() in app.py and call render_html() with HTML strings from src/ui/astronomy_theme.py for styled cards, or use st.* directly for interactive widgets. 2. The response dict from pipeline.answer_question() has keys: answer, sources, retrieved_chunks, evidence, trace, agent_activity, evaluation, citations, citation_coverage, confidence, kb_state, retrieval_mode. 3. _build_meta(response, requested_mode) flattens the response into a display-ready dict. _render_answer_extras(meta) renders that dict under each answer. 4. agent_activity is at response['agent_activity'] and also at response['trace']['agent_activity']. 5. All Streamlit width kwargs go through WIDE = _layout_kwargs() for version compatibility. 6. st.expander() is the pattern for collapsible sections; use expanded=False for secondary info panels.
directory_structure: rag-helpdesk/ — project root with app.py (Streamlit UI, 3520 lines). src/config.py — env-driven config (API keys, paths, top-k values). src/rag_pipeline/ — all RAG logic: pipeline.py (main RAGPipeline class), controller.py (AgentController), retrieval.py (dense/BM25/page/chapter/RRF functions), retrieval_runner.py (execute_retrieval_attempt), evidence.py (evaluate_evidence), context.py (select_context_candidates, build_context), generation.py (ask_llm), models.py (Candidate, Evidence, Citation dataclasses), query.py (prepare_search_query, extract_page_query_info, extract_chapter_query_info). src/document_loader.py — PDF/TXT/MD chunking; writes page_start, page_end, chapter_num, section_title metadata. src/unified_vector_store.py — wraps ChromaVectorStore backend. src/bm25_retriever.py — BM25 index. knowledge_base/ — source documents. vectorstore/ — Chroma DB + BM25 index files. tests/ — pytest test files.
